manifest.note: CPU-only baseline candidate, not a tuned performance claim. OpenMP explicitly off to match previously unavailable runtime; Accelerate enabled.

bootstrap.method: Paired-round percentile bootstrap of the median ratio
bootstrap.resampling_unit: One complete measured round, preserving baseline/candidate pairing

quality_evidence.limitation: Only the supplied report's status was checked. Its build, precision, prompt, position and conversation coverage must be matched manually to the performance comparison; no baseline quality scope is inferred.

limitations: Ratios above1favor the candidate. Intervals summarize paired observations; they do not automatically establish a performance win.
Percentile bootstrap assumes measured rounds are sufficiently exchangeable. It does not remove thermal drift, background activity, affinity differences or systematic benchmark bias.
Intervals are unadjusted for multiple configurations, metrics or contexts. Choosing the best observed result can introduce selection bias.
A passed quality report, when supplied, is evidence only within its own stated scope. This analyzer does not promote it into a general baseline-quality claim.
Single-stream decode, TTFT and request latency remain separate metrics; no composite winner or cross-precision speedup is inferred.

archive_provenance.sanitization: Repository/home prefixes anonymized; process/host/user identifiers omitted. All rounds, timings, outliers and uncertainty preserved; original artifact hashes retained.
